Fox & The Hounds

Festival-style Mumford & Sons-inspired acoustic strolling band. Guaranteed to create intimate and memorable moments with your loved ones ❤️

About Fox & The Hounds

Fox &amp; The Hounds is a Mumford &amp; Sons-inspired roaming band delivering high-energy acoustic sets that bring music up close and personal . Perfect for drinks receptions or mingling moments, they stroll between guests like a modern-day mariachi band. Their 3-piece lineup features lead vocals with acoustic bass , guitar , and sax with harmonies , with the option to add drums or switch to an electric evening set for party vibes. Richard , a powerhouse frontman with perfect pitch and a George Michael-like tone, leads the band with confidence. The full team— Nick, Thiago, and Edu —are seasoned musicians, each with impressive careers touring globally, working with top acts, and building online followings. With over 300 songs in their repertoire across folk, pop, rock, soul, and more , they offer rich harmonies and unforgettable moments. Fox &amp; The Hounds create a heartfelt, interactive live experience that guests remember long after the final note.
